convert_bert_tf_checkpoint: convert a TensorFlow BERT checkpoint to a PyTorch model with TF_CHECKPOINT, TF_CONFIG, and output path
convert_gpt_openai_checkpoint: convert an OpenAI GPT checkpoint to PyTorch with checkpoint folder path and output path
convert_gpt2_tf_checkpoint: convert a TensorFlow GPT-2 checkpoint to PyTorch with TF_CHECKPOINT, optional config, and output path
convert_xlnet_tf_checkpoint: convert a TensorFlow XLNet checkpoint to PyTorch with optional finetuning task name
convert_xlm_checkpoint: convert an XLM checkpoint to PyTorch with checkpoint path and output path
